description: Move one work folder through its life, or correct its record. action close moves open to due (the creator's work is over). harvest_record moves due to harvested and stores receipt_json, a non-empty JSON object saying what was kept; a regenerable folder needs no receipt, any other folder without one is refused. reopen moves due or harvested back to open and clears the current receipt (the history keeps it). retire moves open, due or harvested to retired, which the sweep keeps and which leaves the disk untouched; restore moves retired back to open. correct changes harvest_kind and/or owner of a folder that is not deleted (an empty owner clears it); a correction that changes nothing is refused. Every change is a compare-and-set on version: pass the version you last read as expected_version; if the row has moved, the call is refused with stale_version and writes nothing. A successful change raises the version by one and appends exactly one history event holding the reason and the acting instance, session, model and effort. A move the state does not allow is refused with invalid_transition. A folder becomes deleted only through the sweep, and deleted is terminal; no action here deletes a folder or edits its history.
embedding_description: Close a finished work folder, record its harvest receipt, reopen it when more work arrives, retire it so the sweep keeps it, restore it, or correct its harvest kind or owner. Every change needs the version you last read and is kept in the folder's history.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Work-folder row after the change with keys folder_id, path, state (open|due|harvested|retired), version (the old version plus one), dev, ino, purpose, bound_kind, bound_ref, harvest_kind, owner, harvest_receipt (JSON text: set by harvest_record, empty again after reopen) and advisories (empty).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Say which folder changed, its new state and new version, and the reason given. A harvested folder is now eligible for the sweep to remove; a retired folder is kept.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use the returned version as expected_version for any further change. After harvest_record the folder is removed by sweep_work_folders, not by this call.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Changing the state or the record of one work folder by compare-and-set on its version in the solet's own database
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: stale_version: expected_version no longer matches the row, so something else changed it; nothing was written. unknown_folder: no record has that folder_id. invalid_transition: the move is not allowed from the folder's current state, or the folder is deleted, which is terminal. invalid_field: harvest_kind is not regenerable, evidence_copy or custody_packet; receipt_json is not a non-empty JSON object, or is missing for a folder that is not regenerable; or a correction would change nothing. invalid_argument: action is not one of close, reopen, retire, restore, correct, harvest_record. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound. The code is in data.error_code and prefixes the error text.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For stale_version, call read_work_folders mode show to see the current state and version, decide whether the change is still wanted, and call again with the fresh version. For invalid_transition, read the folder and choose an action its state allows: close from open, harvest_record from due, reopen from due or harvested, retire from open, due or harvested, restore from retired. For invalid_field, fix the named argument. For unknown_folder, find the id with read_work_folders mode list. For state_service_unavailable, wait for the solet to finish starting and retry once.
